# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform baseline and performance**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 raises Apple deployment minimums while improving rendering, pixel access, and text shaping performance. WebAssembly packages now include the WebGPU implementation, Android texture rendering follows display refresh, and managed pixel and HarfBuzz operations avoid unnecessary allocations.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple deployment minimums increased** — iOS and tvOS applications must now target version 14.0 or later, and macOS applications must target version 11.0 or later. Update your application deployment targets before adopting this release. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes GL texture rendering with the display refresh cycle to provide smoother Android rendering. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain their source** — Releases the underlying stream when front-buffered managed streams are disposed, preventing unnecessary retention. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image pixel copies reduce managed overhead** — Optimizes managed image pixel copying to reduce work when transferring image data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **HarfBuzz text processing avoids temporary allocations** — Pools UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocations while preserving text shaping and feature decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly packages include WebGPU support** — Ships emdawnwebgpu's implementation inside the native SkiaSharp library so WebAssembly consumers receive the required WebGPU code with the package. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Apple platform support baseline updated** — Native assets and managed target metadata now align with iOS and tvOS 14.0 and macOS 11.0. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
